newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA August commodity price index down 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA August commodity price index down 0.2 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia's commodity price index for August fell by 0.2 percent in special drawing rights terms after falling by 1.5 percent in July.
Falls in the prices of wheat and sugar were partly offset by a rise in the price of beef, the Reserve Bank said in a statement.
In Australian dollar terms, the index rose by 1.2 percent, following a decline of 0.9 percent in July, it said.
